graph.title: LEGO City 60066 Swamp Police Starter Set
notes: The four remaining groups are real, separate models, so the L3 'separate groups' warning is not a real problem here. The booklet builds a police airboat (pp.5-16), a robbers' raft (pp.17-21), a swamp island (pp.22-27) and a crocodile (pp.28-29) as independent models. Each starts from its own first step with its own base piece, and no step joins one model to another. I did not invent joins between them.

Oars b37/b38, shovel b39 and the backpack banknote b56 are tied to the raft (b36) with 'contact' (rest) edges. The snake b52, handcuffs b53 and flashlight hilt b54 are tied to the island base (b40) the same way. They are carried by minifigures, which are not in the parts list. These edges are not fastened joins.
The flashlight hilt (b54) and trans-yellow round plate (b55) are joined as the flashlight a minifigure holds.
Many stud/anti-stud joins use null ports because the exact studs can't be told from the small step pictures. Which piece sits on which in the airboat (b9, b13 to b15) is partly inferred.

Island: the lime round plate (b51) goes on the leaves (b49), which sit on the bar plate (b48), and the spider (b50) goes on b51. This is inferred from the step 7 picture. The bamboo plant (b47) is joined to the base plate (b40).
Crocodile: the head and tail connect with ball joints (body sockets). The blue pin goes through the tail hole into the body.
The parts list has 60 pieces and every piece appears once.

graph_initial.title: LEGO City 60066 Swamp Police Starter Set
notes: The booklet has three builds (police airboat, robbers' raft, swamp island) plus a crocodile; all are in one graph. Minifigure parts are not in the parts list and are not modelled.
Many stud/anti-stud joins use null ports because the exact studs can't be told from the small step pictures. Which piece sits on which in the airboat (b9, b13 to b15) is partly inferred.
Oars (b37, b38), shovel (b39), handcuffs (b53), snake (b52) and the spare banknote tile (b56, on a minifig backpack) are held by or loose with minifigures, so they have no joined edges.
Hilt (b54) and trans-yellow round plate (b55) form the flashlight held by a minifigure.

Island: the lime round plate (b51) goes on the leaves (b49), which sit on the bar plate (b48), and the spider (b50) goes on b51. This is inferred from the step 7 picture. The bamboo plant (b47) is joined to the base plate (b40).
Crocodile: the head and tail connect with ball joints (body sockets). The blue pin goes through the tail hole into the body.
The booklet is for set 60066; the parts list has 60 pieces and every piece appears once.
